content: Na-Adam-jinyung warra-mijgalgur-yung.

Anaani ana-wubiba wu-magina na-Adam-jinyung marri nigawi-nyinyung warra-mijgalgur-yung. Anu…bani-yunggaj, na-God nu-maṉdhangi naagi-yung na-waḻyinyung. Nu-maṉdhangi, ni-yamaa nguynju nigawi-yii na-God-jii.
Wani-maṉdhangi waḻyinyung marri maṉinyung. Naagi-yung waniigajij-majgaa, anubani wani-mayaa “warra-wurru-wurruj”.

Naagi-yung na-Adam ni-burri 130 anaagalhal-aḻirr. Bani-yung marri nu-lhamayn na-niwiyayung. Naagi-yung ni-yamaa nguynju nigawi-yii na-Adam-jii, wini-yi-nguynju. Nigaayung na-Adam nu-mij-gayn na-nimuwaj-jung Seth.
Anubanila-wala, na-Adam ni-burri 800 anaagalhal-aḻirr. Warra-miniwiyayung marri warra-miyn.ngarriwiyayung wani-waṉagaa.
Nigawi-nyinyung ana-wiri ni-burri-yinyung manaarmag 930, baḏag. Naagi-yung bani-yung marri ni-ngawiiyn.
Nigaayung naagi-yung na-Seth, ni-burri 105 anaagalhal-aḻirr. Bani-yung marri nu-lhamayn naagi-yung na-niwiyayung na-Enosh.
Ngijang anubanila-wala Seth nigaayung ni-burri naagi-yung 807 anaagalhal-aḻirr. Warra-mininiwiyayung marri warra-miyn.ngarriwiyayung anubani-yumbaa wurru-burri.
Nigawi-nyinyung ana-wiri ni-burri-yinyung anaagalhal-aḻirr 912. Marri bani-yung ni-ngawiiyn.
Nigaayung na-Enosh, ni-burri 90 anaagalhal-aḻirr.
Anubanila-wala nigaayung nu-lhamayn na-Kenan. Anubanila-wala ni-burri naadagi-yung na-Enosh, nigaayung 815 anaagalhal-aḻirr. Warra-mininiwiyayung marri warra-miyn.ngarriwiyayung wuu-yagaynjini.
Nigawi-nyinyung ana-wiri ni-burri-yinyung anaagalhal-aḻirr 905. Bani-yung marri ni-ngawiiyn.
Na-Kenan naagi-yung 70 anaagalhal-aḻirr, ni-burri. Bani-yung marri nu-lhamayn Mahalalel, na-niwiyayung.
Anubanila-wala, na-Kenan ni-burri 840 anaagalhal-aḻirr. Warra-mininiwiyayung marri warra-miyn.ngarriwiyayung wuu-yagaynjini.
Nigawi-nyinyung ana-wiri ni-burri-yinyung 910 anaagalhal-aḻirr. Marri bani-yung ni-ngawiiyn.
Nigaayung na-Mahalalel 65 anaagalhal-aḻirr, naagi-yung ni-burri. Bani-yung marri nu-lhamayn naagi-yung na-nimuwaj-jung na-Jared.
Anubanila, na-Mahalalel naagi-yung ni-burri 830 anaagalhal-aḻirr. Wani-lhamaa warra-mininiwiyayung marri warra-miyn.ngarriwiyayung.
Ana-wiri nigawi-nyinyung ni-burri-yinyung, 895 anaagalhal-aḻirr. Bani-yung marri ni-ngawiiyn.
Nigaayung naagi-yung na-Jared ni-burri anaagalhal-aḻirr 162. Bani-yung marri nu-lhamayn na-Enoch.
Anubanila-wala ni-burri na-Jared 800 anaagalhal-aḻirr. Wani-lhamaa warra-mininiwiyayung marri warra-miyn.ngarriwiyayung.
Anubani ana-wiri ni-burri-yinyung, 962. Bani-yung marri naagi-yung ni-ngawiiyn.
Na-Enoch niga naagi-yung 65 ni-burri anaagalhal-aḻirr. Bani-yung marri naagi-yung nu-lhamayn na-niwiyayung Methuselah.
Naagi-yung na-Enoch winiinggarra-yanggi na-God, baḏag 300 anaagalhal-aḻirr. Niimbuḻwiyn-gala na-Methuselah, na-Enoch naagi-yung wani-lhamaa miniwiyayung marri miyn.ngarriwiyayung.
Anaani-rruj ni-burri 365 anaagalhal-aḻirr.
Wini-yagaynjini naagi-yung na-God, winiinggarra-yanggi. Anubanila-wala na-Enoch niiṉibiyn. God nu-yarini niga.
Methuselah naagi-yung ni-burri 187 anaagalhal-aḻirr. Bani-yung marri naagi-yung nu-lhamayn na-Lamech, na-niwiyayung.
Anubanila-wala, na-Methuselah naagi-yung ni-burri 782 anaagalhal-aḻirr. Wani-lhamaa warra-mininiwiyayung marri warra-miyn.ngarriwiyayung.
Anubani 969 ana-wiri nigawi-nyinyung. Marri bani-yung ni-ngawiiyn.
Na-Lamech naagi-yung ni-burri 182 anaagalhal-aḻirr. Bani-yung marri nu-lhamayn naagi-yung na-niwiyayung.

Nu-mij-gayn na-niwiyayung na-Noah. Ni-yamayn, “Na-Yawei na-God anubani-yunggaj niwu-rraani anaani anaaban. Marri ngurru-mijgalmina, marri ngurru-waṉbina angudu aynba-gaynbaj-jinyung, marang-mirri. Naagi na-nigi ngaambani-maṉmani, anaani-rruj anaaban-duj.” Dani-yung ni-yamayn naagi-yung na-Lamech.
Anubanila-wala, niimbuḻwiyn-gala na-Noah, naagi-yung na-Lamech ni-burri 595 anaagalhal-aḻirr. Wani-lhamaa warruburru warra-mininiwiyayung marri warra-miyn.ngarriwiyayung.
Anubani nigawi-nyinyung ana-wiri ni-burri-yinyung, 777. Marri bani-yung ni-ngawiiyn.
Na-Noah naagi-yung ni-burri 500 anaagalhal-aḻirr. Naagi wani-lhamaa Shem, Ham marri Japheth, warraawurru wurru-wulaynbaj warra-miniwiyayung.
